what: Wall-time ratio photutils.isophote / isoster on a synthetic Sersic grid. Every case also had to pass the script's accuracy criteria against the true profile; a case that failed those would not be a valid speed comparison. This is a synthetic sweep, not a real-image benchmark.
caveat: Absolute times are machine-specific; the ratio is the portable part. One run on one machine: treat the median and quartiles as the reproducible summary and the extremes as provisional.
